About WeGolden

A gold-first broker built on transparency

WeGolden is a global fintech broker for gold, forex and CFDs. It started as an investment group in South Africa in 2022, earned its FSCA licence in 2023 and launched the WeGolden brand for retail traders in 2025.

Our mission is simple: use technology to make trading more transparent, from blockchain-recorded trade history to a copy-trading community where experienced traders and beginners grow together.

“WeTrade. WeCopy. WeWin.”

FAQ

Product FAQ

Ada soalan?
What is the smallest trade I can open?

0.01 lot. Forex and metals go up to 30 lots per order; other symbols show their limits in MT5.

When does my leverage drop?

As equity grows (see the table above), and to 1:100 during the daily close and open (23:00–02:00), over the weekend, and 15 minutes before and after high-impact news.

What are the margin call and stop-out levels?

Margin call at 150% margin level, stop-out at 20%.

Which account should I start with?

Cent to learn or test an EA with small capital, Standard for no-commission gold and FX trading, ECN for the tightest spreads and high volume.

Do you offer Islamic (swap-free) accounts?

Islamic accounts are coming soon. Meanwhile, the Free Swap promotion removes overnight swap on forex, metals, indices and energies.

What counts as a qualifying trade

  • Opened after your deposit or bonus credit
  • GoldFlash: held 180+ seconds and ±3 pips or more
  • 20% bonus: held 120+ seconds and 30+ pips

What does not count

  • Copy-trading positions
  • Hedged positions (only one side counts)
  • Cancelled or deleted pending orders
  • Arbitrage, split trades or other bonus abuse

One offer at a time

Accounts with an active bonus cannot join GoldFlash. Use separate accounts if you want different promotions.

Free Swap holding limits

Gold, silver, WTI, Brent, USDCAD, JPY crosses, minors and exotics held longer than 5 days may be charged swap.
